chunks: And in the narration of al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who had intercourse with his mukātabah, he said: “If she had paid a quarter, the hadd is to be inflicted upon him, and if he was muḥṣan, he is to be stoned. But if she had not paid anything, then there is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.أَدَّتِ الرُّبُعَ: she paid one quarter of the contract amount
key_terms.مُحْصَنًا: legally married and protected in a way that entails the ruling of rajm for zinā
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَتِهِ: his slave-woman under a manumission contract

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his mukātabah slave-woman after she has partially paid her contract?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a man who has intercourse with his mukātabah slave-woman. The ruling distinguishes between whether she has paid part of her manumission contract, making legal liability depend on her degree of contractual emancipation, and it also mentions the ruling of rajm for a muḥṣan.
